## Summary

What does this change and why is it needed?

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Test / CI improvement
- [ ] Other

## How to test

Describe the exact steps a reviewer can use to verify the change.

```bash
php artisan test
vendor/bin/pint --test
```

## Screenshots

Add before/after screenshots for visible UI changes when relevant.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not bundle unrelated work.
- [ ] Existing behavior remains covered, or I added/updated tests.
- [ ] `php artisan test` passes.
- [ ] `vendor/bin/pint --test` passes.
- [ ] I updated documentation for user-facing behavior.
- [ ] I did not add `.env` values, credentials, production data, or private client assets.
- [ ] Database changes are represented by migrations rather than destructive manual instructions.
